stock.description: Freetech Road Recycling Technology (Holdings) Limited, an investment holding firm established in 1993 and based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, primarily focuses on the production and distribution of road upkeep equipment across the People's Republic of China. The company's services extend to providing comprehensive road maintenance solutions, notably offering specialized asphalt pavement maintenance (APM) equipment and services for repairing damaged asphalt surfaces, all marketed under its "Road Doctor" brand. Its diversified operations are organized into three key divisions: Maintenance Services, Equipment Sales, and Properties. Additionally, Freetech is also active in the buying, selling, and leasing of real estate.
